assets.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
assets.label: REUSABLE PACK DELIVERY
assets.factualConcept: Pando preserves Git workflows while independently accepting unrelated ref pushes, reusing immutable packs and multilevel covers, and separating fetch planning from regional Express cache delivery. A pack can depend on a shared trunk history.
